class.name: LLMModel
class.brief_description: Loads a GGUF model file for in-process LLM inference.
class.description: Wraps a llama.cpp [code]llama_model*[/code]. GPU acceleration is automatic: Metal on macOS/iOS, Vulkan on Linux/Windows/Android, WebGPU on web. [method load] is asynchronous — it returns immediately and emits [signal loaded] or [signal load_failed] when done. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var model = LLMModel.new() model.model_path = "/path/to/model.gguf" model.n_gpu_layers = -1 # -1 = all layers on GPU model.loaded.connect(func(): ctx.create(model)) model.load_failed.connect(func(e): push_error(e)) model.load() [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the model is currently loaded.

method.name: is_loading
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a [method load] call is in progress.

method.name: load
method.description: Starts loading the model from [member model_path] on a background thread. Returns [constant OK] if the thread started successfully, or an error if [member model_path] is empty or the model is already loaded/loading. Connect to [signal loaded] and [signal load_failed] to receive the result.

method.name: supports_audio
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a projector is loaded and the model accepts audio input. Returns [code]false[/code] when [member mmproj_path] is unset, when the projector failed to load, or on a platform built without multimodal support.

method.name: supports_vision
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a projector is loaded and the model accepts image input. Returns [code]false[/code] when [member mmproj_path] is unset, when the projector failed to load, or on a platform built without multimodal support.

method.name: unload
method.description: Frees the loaded model and releases GPU/CPU memory.

members.member: Path to a multimodal projector in GGUF form. Empty means text only. The projector is loaded after the text model, because it needs one. A projector that fails to load is not fatal: the model still serves text and [method supports_vision] reports [code]false[/code], so a wrong or missing file degrades rather than stopping the load.
Path to the GGUF model file. Accepts absolute or [code]res://[/code] paths.
Number of model layers to offload to GPU. [code]-1[/code] offloads all layers. Set to [code]0[/code] to force CPU-only inference.
Lock model weights in RAM to prevent them from being swapped out.
Use memory-mapped file I/O for model loading. Reduces RAM usage when multiple processes share the same model file.

signal.name: load_failed
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread when model loading fails.

signal.name: loaded
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread when the model has been successfully loaded.
